summary: First-finish smoke test of Rudaya Power Finance Tracker. Backend auth, transactions, meta, and reports all healthy. Frontend login, dashboard KPIs/charts, transactions listing/filtering, transaction drawer, Project P&L, Monthly and Settings pages render correctly. Logout works.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials returns user + JWT token (200)
GET /api/reports/summary matches expected: revenue 46,21,777.74; cost 35,43,755.5; expense 3,29,420.63; gross_profit 10,78,022.24; net_profit 7,48,601.61
GET /api/reports/project-pnl returns aggregated rows per project
Login UI: /login flow with admin creds redirects to dashboard
Dashboard KPI cards render with correct INR-formatted values (₹46,21,778 / ₹35,43,756 / ₹10,78,022 / ₹3,29,421 / ₹7,48,602)
Dashboard charts (chart-monthly-rev-vs-exp, chart-net-profit-trend) and recent-transactions table visible
Transactions page: 120 rows rendered; add-transaction-btn opens right-side drawer with all fields (date/type/account/amount/project/notes/save)
Type filter (Revenue) narrows table to 9 rows (matches backend count)
Project P&L page renders 12 project rows + TOTAL footer with correct aggregates
Monthly page renders 6 rows (Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep 2026) plus bar chart
Settings page loads with add-project and add-account inputs
Logout clears session and redirects to /login
action_items: Minor (non-blocking): Recharts logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings during initial mount of some charts on route change; consider setting a minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parent.
